title: Injectivity part of associated-module Hom
statement: For X, M and G as in lem-weil-pbc-associated-module-hom, the canonical-section map on morphisms is injective.

proof.text: This is the corresponding injectivity/surjectivity part of the universal-property argument for associated modules.

mathlib_searches.query: morphisms from the sheaf of modules associated to M into G correspond to R-linear maps from M to global sections of G
mathlib_searches.results: SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv (Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf.lean: Hom(unit R, M) ≃ M.sections, the case M = R), SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv (Sheaf/Free.lean: Hom(free I, M) ≃ (I → M.sections), the case M free), PresheafOfModules.sheafifyHomEquiv, PresheafOfModules.sheafificationHomEquiv, SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_comp_apply
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: only the free case (freeHomEquiv) is in Mathlib; the general module needs the associated-module construction, absent
